facts.premium: Agricultural central-Isan province; ~90% informal, low incomes.
facts.skill_gap: Thin formal sector; smallholder farming and self-employment dominate.
anchors: Silk weaving (Phu Phan / Phrae Wa silk)
workers: Rice, cassava and cane farmers and farm labour
impacts: Rain-fed rice and cane make income weather-dependent.
Cassava income hit by ~20%+ YoY price falls (OAE).
Firmer cane prices support mill-area income at crush time.
Households depend on transfers from migrant workers.
Low vehicle stock, motorcycle-dominant; thin-ticket collateral.
